name: Autonomous ICU Sepsis Early-Warning & Order System
description: An AI system embedded in the ICU EHR continuously analyzes vital signs and lab results to autonomously trigger a sepsis alert and pre-order a treatment bundle without requiring nurse or physician sign-off before the order fires. Deployed across ICUs in Germany and France.

name: Imaging Prior-Authorization Decision Engine
description: Reviews physician requests for advanced imaging (MRI/CT) and auto-approves or flags for human review based on a risk score trained on historical claims data; used by a regional payer operating in Colorado and other states.

name: Patient Portal Symptom Triage Chatbot
description: A generative-AI chatbot on the hospital patient portal answers symptom questions and recommends whether to seek ER, urgent care, or self-care; all recommendations are advisory and a nurse triage line reviews any chatbot session flagged urgent.

name: Radiology Second-Read AI for Chest X-rays
autonomy: Human makes final decision, AI is one input
description: FDA-cleared software provides a second read on chest X-rays with a probability score and saliency heatmap; the radiologist independently reviews every case and makes the final read regardless of the AI output.

name: Internal Nurse & Technician Shift-Scheduling Optimizer
description: An in-house optimization model suggests weekly nurse and technician shift schedules based on predicted patient volume; staffing managers can override any suggested schedule before it is published.

name: Genomic Population-Health Outreach Enrollment Model
description: Uses genomic and claims data to compute a predictive risk score, using historical healthcare cost as a proxy for medical need, and automatically enrolls the highest-scoring members into a care-management outreach program without staff review.

name: Early-Stage Drug Candidate Generation Model
autonomy: Human makes final decision, AI is one input
description: A generative model proposes novel candidate small-molecule structures for early-stage drug discovery using a fully de-identified and synthetic molecular dataset; medicinal chemists evaluate and select candidates for synthesis.
